scenes.vo: Your phone is making you shorter. Seriously.
Slouching compresses your spine and hides up to two inches of your natural height.
Don't worry. You can reclaim your height with three simple posture habits.
Number one: chin tucks. Pull your head straight back to decompress your neck.
Number two: wall angels. Two minutes against a wall resets rounded shoulders.
Number three: eye level screen. Lift your phone up instead of looking down.
And there's way more inside our app. Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
